description: Retrieves explore data for an organization as a timeseries for a selected dataset and aggregate axis, optionally grouped by top events.

comparisonDelta.description: The delta in seconds to return additional offset timeseries by.
comparisonDelta.title: Comparison Delta

dataset.description: Which dataset to query. Changing datasets changes the available fields that can be queried. Options: 'logs', 'profile_functions', 'spans', 'uptime_results'.
dataset.title: Dataset

end.description: The end of the period of time for the query, expected in ISO-8601 format. For example, `2001-12-14T12:34:56.7890`. This parameter is ignored if `statsPeriod` is provided.
end.title: End

environment.description: The name of environments to filter by.
environment.title: Environment

excludeOther.description: Whether to include the 'other' timeseries in TopEvents queries.
excludeOther.title: ExcludeOtherEnum

groupBy.description: List of fields to group by. *Required* for topEvents queries as this and sort determine what the top events are.
groupBy.title: Group By

interval.description: The size of the bucket for the timeseries to have, must be a value smaller than the window being queried. If the interval is invalid a default interval will be selected instead.
interval.title: Interval

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

preventMetricAggregates.description: Whether to throw an error when aggregates are passed.
preventMetricAggregates.title: PreventMetricAggregatesEnum

project.description: The IDs of projects to filter by. `-1` means all available projects. For example, the following are valid parameters: `[1234, 56789]` or `[-1]`.
project.title: Project

query.description: Filters results by using query syntax. Example: `(transaction:foo AND release:abc) OR (transaction:[bar,baz] AND release:def)`.
query.title: Query

sort.description: What to order the results of the query by. Must be something in the `field` list, excluding equations.
sort.title: Sort

start.description: The start of the period of time for the query, expected in ISO-8601 format. For example, `2001-12-14T12:34:56.7890`. This parameter is ignored if `statsPeriod` is provided.
start.title: Start

statsPeriod.description: The period of time for the query, will override the start & end parameters. A number followed by one of: 'd' (days), 'h' (hours), 'm' (minutes), 's' (seconds), 'w' (weeks). For example, `24h` means query data starting from 24 hours ago to now.
statsPeriod.title: Stats Period

topEvents.description: The number of top event results to return, must be between 1 and 10. When topEvents is passed, both sort and groupBy are required parameters.
topEvents.title: Top Events

yAxis.description: The aggregate field to create the timeseries for, defaults to `count()` when not included.
yAxis.title: Y Axis

name: query_explore_events_in_timeseries_format

meta.description: Metadata about the timeseries response including dataset and time range.
meta.title: Meta

timeSeries.description: Array of timeseries items, each containing values and metadata for one or more axis/groupings.
timeSeries.title: Time Series

TimeseriesItem.description: Individual timeseries item with values and metadata.

groupBy.description: The groupBy fields and their values for this timeseries.
groupBy.title: Group By

yAxis.description: The aggregate field this timeseries represents.
yAxis.title: Y Axis

TimeseriesItem.title: TimeseriesItem

end.description: The end timestamp of the query period as a UNIX timestamp (seconds since epoch).
end.title: End

start.description: The start timestamp of the query period as a UNIX timestamp (seconds since epoch).
start.title: Start
